title: Payment API latency spike
symptoms: Checkout requests timing out; p95 latency jumped from 420ms to 4.8s
logs: db_pool: active=100 max=100; timeout acquiring connection; payment-api 5xx=18%
lesson: When payment-api latency spikes after a deployment, check database connection-pool saturation before restarting Redis.

title: Payment API degradation
symptoms: Checkout requests slow; elevated 5xx responses; database connections near maximum
logs: db_pool: active=98 max=100; timeout acquiring connection; payment-api 5xx=15%
lesson: A similar payment-api incident was caused by connection-pool exhaustion; Redis restart was ineffective.

title: Order API memory spike
symptoms: Order service memory climbs continuously after deployment
logs: heap_used=91%; GC pause increasing; container restart count=4
lesson: When memory grows continuously after a release, inspect the new release before scaling blindly.
